playbook.claim: Use persistent decision loops for recurring marketing and operating questions so weekly decisions compound instead of being recreated in disconnected chats.
playbook.mechanism: Store separate repeatable loops for market gaps, objection handling, creative-angle testing, retention, and weekly metric review; feed each loop the latest evidence and require one next action.

playbook.claim: A faceless channel can create a consistent identity with one fixed voice, frequent visual changes, captions, and a minimum publishing sample before evaluation.
playbook.mechanism: Choose one recognizable narration voice, change B-roll every 3–5 seconds, add captions for silent viewers, publish 20–30 units before judging the format, and compare retention across batches.

playbook.claim: An ASO agent workflow can combine keyword research, metadata optimization, competitor analysis, and app-growth review into one preflight cycle.
playbook.mechanism: Before each store update, have an agent produce a keyword set, compare competitor metadata, draft title/subtitle/description variants, and output a change log with hypotheses for the next measurement window.

playbook.claim: Separate Apple Search Ads management into four campaign groups to make keyword discovery, control, and reporting easier to isolate.
playbook.mechanism: Create distinct campaigns for brand, category/generic, competitor, and discovery terms; assign different budgets and promotion rules, then move validated search terms into the controlled group.

ad_swipe.impressions_null_reason: App Store Lookup metadata provides ratings and rating counts, not impressions.
ad_swipe.why_it_works: The listing differentiates from generic affirmation apps by promising delivery at emotionally relevant moments, then explains the concrete flow from notification to card.
ad_swipe.replication_plan: Test storefront copy that names a specific trigger moment, pairs it with one immediate action, and contrasts proactive delivery with requiring the user to open the app; measure store-page conversion against a generic daily-affirmation variant.
